notes.title: Release notes for 18/08/2024
notes.content:
Update 0.030J - Preview / Default branch
BuildID: 0.030J


Main Changes:
*Hello friends,*
*the time has come and we are finally releasing newest {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531163/1887ebc83edf29216ed5287694129a4ae2bb72db.pngupdate for the pre-alpha testers to play with and help in testing of course. This update took us longer than we expected but introduces quite a lot of new stuff and is very important for the future of the game. Please do test the build as much as you can and help us find all the bugs and problems that can occur before another big update. Important thing is even balance changes that we will base on your suggestions. So do tell us how you feel about the new systems and if you think they are setup correctly or not! You will find all changes written below as always :) 
PLEASE DO TEST THIS BUILD AND LET US KNOW IF EVERYTHING WORKS AS IT SHOULD :) THANK YOU FOR BEING HERE WITH US ON THIS JOURNEY!

Technical Changelog:

Added:

	Added currency - money to the game - you can find money in dead zombies, characters or loot boxes
	Added new inventory UI and new icons
	Added descriptions for items
	Added upgrades to the working stations - stash, and crafting stations
	Added stamina, energy, food and thirst systems (they do work together and affect each other as in real life, make sure you take food and drinks with you to the zone)
	Added new military locations to the zone
	Added new road to the military location
	Added destroyed buildings
	Added new map to the tablet
	Added filters to vendors in safe house zone
	Added buy / sell function
	Added visual changes to the crafting stations after updates
	Added Self revive for solo players (if youre playing solo you can revive up to 5 times, every time you revive, your overall health pool declines by 20%)
	Added loot to all animals (meat)
	Added secure container
	Added food / drink system - drinks or food have always number of uses on them and they are random
	Added new icons for tablet
	Added magazine system for guns
	Added bullets / shells for guns
	Added crafting of poison and fire bullets / shells
	Added guns, ammo, attachments, food, drinks etc. to the safe house so players can pick
	Added new river
	Added new sounds
	Added decay system to the foliage (during the match in the zone foliage is dying through the whole day, before sundown everything is bleak and dying)
	Added new hand accesorries
	Added canted sights system


Changed:

	Changed optimizations on AI
	Changed behaviour of Werewolf - will be a bigger threat
	Changed shooter behaviours
	Changed animations for eating / drinking
	Changed animations for AR / AK guns
	Changed a lot of car models
	Changed the look of most of the locations
	Changed inventory system with stats
	Changed stamina system
	Changed roads, bridges in safe house zone


Fixed:

	Fixed bug with PDA after vaulting
	Fixed small audio issues
	Fixed spatial loading and spawning of BOSS AI
	Fixed PDA bug when no items
	Fixed AI sliding
	Fixed small fixes
	Fixed shooter collisions
	Overall fixes to the new systems


Known Issues:

	Flickering of the hand (tied to animation and movement)
	Tilted camera (jump to fix)

Hello friends,
this is one of the most important updates and builds we have prepared as we will be sending it soon to possible publishers and other important people for review. What does it mean? Definitely not a stop in development or anything else. It just means this update should be great in every term - performance, stability, options for players, gear, boss state, overall gameplay etc. You will find all changes written below as always :) 

PLEASE DO TEST THIS BUILD AND LET US KNOW IF EVERYTHING WORKS AS IT SHOULD :) THANK YOU FOR BEING HERE WITH US ON THIS JOURNEY, IM GOING TO WORK ON ANOTHER UPDATE RIGHT AWAY :)

notes.title: Release notes for 23/02/2024

Update 0.023 - Preview


Main Changes:
*Hey people,* 🙂
*it's already a week again and we will be testing the game together :) (feel free to join us). We wanted to make the update bigger with new loot system but the loot generation is still not finished, so you will not see it in this build yet. But don't worry there is quite a lot of other changes we have prepared :) hope you will like this release as much as the older ones!

PS: This build has not as good performance as the previous one, so if you want to run the game smoothly stay on the default branch of the build until we fix the performance on PREVIEW build (This version is released on preview and default for tonights testing, will be rollbacked on default branch after that)*

notes.title: Release notes for 11/02/2024
notes.content:
Hey people, 🙂

another week is behind us and we will be testing the game together again :) (so feel free to join us). This update is once again based on our latest test we did a week ago and should directly affect the problems we experienced during the gameplay. Hopefully we have fixed and improved on all of that and this update will bring the game closer to the fullly fun matches. There is several new things that you can look for in the game, so I Will see ya in the game!!!

Technical Changelog:

Added:

	Added new Police Central in the city
	Added new Siren sounds
	Added Health, Stamina and other stats to UI (Your health and Stamina Icons show on the screen during game version 1 (will be able to hide the stats and autohide in next build)
	Added Compass
	Added save state system for doors, zombies etc.
	Added replication to all the zombie sounds
	Added replication to AI clothing
	Added shooters to the Cave location
	Added MALL center loading hierarchy
	Added key mechanics for card unlocks, key unlocks etc.


Changed:

	Changed materials and their effects on several new props
	Changed small details in most of the locations
	Changed footstep sounds so they can be heard better and further away
	Changed stamina recovery rate - Stamina now recovers slowly, lasts longer and the recovery starts after 2 seconds of not running
	Changed the way Subway is loaded (loads after you enter) so id doesnt take such a heavy toll on performance
	Changed the way states of all the interactable objects are handled in the game


Fixed:

	Optimization and loading fixes
		 Performance in the city is much better
	Optimization on AI
	Optimization of pickup items
	Optimization of vehicles and doors
	Zombies respawning after you leave the zone no more
	Door repliaction in prison :)


Known Issues:

	Bad animations
	Flickering of the hand (tied to animation and movement)
	Tilted camera (jump to fix)
